	<article
 id="post-2293"
 class="post-2293 page type-page status-publish hentry">
 <div class="entry-content is-layout-constrained">
 <div data-elementor-type="wp-page" data-elementor-id="2293" class="elementor elementor-2293" data-elementor-post-type="page">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5b553ec e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="5b553ec" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="e-con-inner">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5350829 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5350829" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Liberan surf &amp; Kite</p> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-21e8ea2 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="21e8ea2" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Ride The Wind With Us!</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b3c564a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="b3c564a" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5fb6b69 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5fb6b69" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Whether you want to nail your first water‑start or chase high‑wind foiling sessions, you’re learning (or leveling up) where Croatian windsports began— and the vibe’s as authentic as the sea breeze.</p> </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-cf4f163 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="cf4f163" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3234a35 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="3234a35" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ca97a04 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="ca97a04" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c486e5e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c486e5e" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-585796a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="585796a" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ede0cee e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="ede0cee" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3f85571 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="3f85571" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default"><h2>Welcome to LIBERAN Surf &amp; Kite center — One of pioneering school that helped put Croatian windsports on the map!</h2></h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-965b8e8 elementor-view-default elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon" data-id="965b8e8" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="icon.default">
 <div class="elementor-icon-wrapper">
 <div class="elementor-icon">
 <svg></svg> </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-cfb602c elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="cfb602c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Since the 70s, LIBERAN has been the heart of windsurfing and kitesurfing in Viganj, Croatia. We combine a laid-back approach with top-notch surf &amp; kite instructors. Our team of passionate, multilingual instructors are here to make sure you have fun, feel confident, and fall in love with the wind and waves of the Croatian coastline!</p> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-fbbfc6f elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-button" data-id="fbbfc6f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="button.default">
 <a class="elementor-button elementor-button-link elementor-size-sm" href="https://antony-boy.com/about/">
 <span class="elementor-button-content-wrapper">
 <span class="elementor-button-icon">
 <svg></svg> </span>
 <span class="elementor-button-text">Learn more</span>
 </span>
 </a>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e02ee18 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="e02ee18" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c96072d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c96072d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p><strong>Why it matters</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Heritage you can trust</strong> – half a century of know‑how means slick logistics, dialed‑in safety and zero rookie mistakes.</li><li><strong>Europe‑class conditions</strong> – Viganj is famed for its steady afternoon thermals and 260+ sunny days a year.</li><li><strong>On‑site expertise</strong> – certified, world‑class instructors who’ve taught everyone from total beginners to pro riders.</li><li><strong>Guest perks</strong> – flash your voucher for <strong>10</strong><strong> % off</strong> any LIBERAN lesson or rental in peak season and even <strong>20</strong><strong> % off</strong> in the low season.</li><li><strong>Gear that delivers</strong> – fresh quivers of sails, kites, wings and foils swapped out every season.</li><li><strong>Progress made simple</strong> – step‑by‑step coaching if you’re new; fine‑tuned clinics and premium rentals if you already shred.</li><li><strong>We teach in accordance with IKO and PZKite guidelines and methodology.</strong></li></ul> </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-64a35f9 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="64a35f9" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-672f0b7 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="672f0b7" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c9de64f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c9de64f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Whether you want to nail your first water‑start or chase high‑wind foiling sessions, you’re learning (or leveling up) where Croatian windsports began—and the vibe’s as authentic as the sea breeze.<br />For more details about our offer, send us an inquiry!</p> </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-be2a185 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="be2a185" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="e-con-inner">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-37dcae8 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="37dcae8" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-772dd93 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="772dd93" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
